name: anvil
description: Anvil — autonomous hardware-design harness for Claude Code. AutoForge's hardware sibling: requirements → schematic → simulation → layout → fab-ready PCB, every gate mechanical (kicad-cli ERC/DRC, ngspice assertions, pinned-catalog BOM cost).

plugins.name: anvil
plugins.description: Autonomous electronics-design engine. 5 commands: anvil (metric loop), build (gated V-model pipeline), requirements (HRS), improve (cost/area/margin optimization under a non-regression ratchet), evals. Gating electrical dimension; parts ordering always human-gated.
